decoded.meaning: SPEC{NAME "name" NAME "up", NAME "config" SETTINGS{NAME "addr" NAME "10.0.0.9", NAME "port" VALUE u16=9000}} — RFC-0014 §2 `spec-name-in-use`: the same name as a live connection, a DIFFERENT config; refused `tr::path::in_use` (0x0022), and the live connection is NOT reconfigured
decoded.note: Deliberately not a byte-for-byte replay of `conn/create-via-spec`: the config differs, so the vector pins BOTH halves of RFC-0014's ruling (i) — the create is refused AND re-SPEC is not a reconfiguration door. `PATH_IN_USE` is idempotent-safe: a retrying orchestrator reads it as "already exists". Changing a key is retire-and-re-create (§Erratum 2026-08-13, #1070), never a second SPEC.
